skill_name: Create a contrasting adjectives list for the following emotion.
workflow: Joyful vs. Mourning, Exhilarating vs. Weary, Elated vs. Discouraged, Jubilant vs. Gloomy, Ecstatic vs. Despondent, Optimistic vs. Pessimistic, Radiant vs. Depressed, Enthralled vs. Miserable, Thrilled vs. Despairing.
